entries.title: Hyper Light Drifter
entries.definitive_edition: Hyper Light Drifter: Special Edition on iOS/iPadOS; Switch Special Edition as console secondary

emulation.notes: Use a native iPad/iPad Pro for the primary route; use native Switch hardware for the secondary complete console route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Up to 120 fps on supported iPad Pro hardware; 60 fps on Switch/iPhone/iPad.

primary.why: Special Edition includes exclusive content and runs at 60 fps on iPhone/iPad, with 120 fps support on iPad Pro. The original PC release is easier to capture but is not the most complete version because it lacks Special Edition content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Hyper Light Drifter: Special Edition on the App Store and play on a modern iPad/iPad Pro for the most complete high-frame-rate route. Use the Switch Special Edition as the more console-friendly complete route.

secondary.why: Switch Special Edition includes the same exclusive content family and is the best console/capture-friendly way to see it.

all_releases.reason: skip: excellent capture route, but not the most complete version because Special Edition content is exclusive to Switch/mobile routes.
skip: same original-release content family; Special Edition is the complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Hyper Light Drifter: Special Edition at 60 fps on iPhone/iPad and up to 120 fps on iPad Pro.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-frame-rate complete route with Special Edition exclusive content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the easiest archival capture route, but Special Edition has exclusive content and higher iPad Pro frame-rate support. Primary is therefore iOS/iPadOS Special Edition, with Switch Special Edition tracked as the capture-friendly secondary.

entries.remaster_caveats: Special Edition is an enhanced port with exclusive content, not a sequel. Canceled PlayStation Vita and Wii U versions are not listed as releases.

entries.title: Solar Ash

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Solar Ash is available on PC, PlayStation, Switch, and Xbox. Windows PC is the best fidelity/capture route and no platform-exclusive content is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Solar Ash on Steam or Epic Games Store for Windows PC and play the current build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release, first through Epic Games Store and later Steam.

entries.title: Hyper Light Breaker
entries.definitive_edition: Hyper Light Breaker Steam Early Access build on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Hyper Light Breaker released only on Windows PC through Steam Early Access. It is the only playable route, but development has ended before a full 1.0 release.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Hyper Light Breaker on Steam for Windows PC if the Early Access build is still available; treat it as an unfinished/canceled-development entry rather than a final complete game.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Steam Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced playable release route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no alternate released platform; the only playable version is the Windows PC Early Access build.

entries.remaster_caveats: Development stopped before a full 1.0 release, so this is an unfinished Early Access archive entry rather than a complete final release.
